units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74">Gen. R. s. 74</cite>, beg. <he>שאינן נוֹשְׁכִין ואוכלין וכ׳</he> they do not bite off and eat, but out &c.; Pesik. Par., p. 34ᵃ; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:23">Koh. R. to VII, 23</cite>.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 37:8">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXVII</cite> <he>אל תהי קורא וישקהו אלא וַיִּשָּׁכֵהוּ</he> read not, ‘and he kissed him’ (<cite ref="Genesis 33:4">Gen. XXXIII, 4</cite>) but, ‘and he bit him.’ <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 1:5">Tosef. B. Kam. I, 5</cite> <he>אינה מועדת … לִישּׁוֹךְ</he> is not considered as forewarned (v. <cite ref="M00556"><he>מוּעָד</he></cite>) as regards … biting; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>נָשׁוּךְ</he>, f. <he>נְשׁוּכָה</he> &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>רופא … בלשונו נְשׁוּךְ נחש</he> a physician that comes to heal with his tongue (charm) one bitten by a serpent.
Ter. VIII, 6 נְשׁוּכַת הנחש וכ׳ any food showing traces of being bitten at by a serpent is forbidden &c.; a. fr.—Trnsf. to adhere to, be affixed.

Pes. 48ᵇ ככרות … שנוֹשְׁכוֹת זו מזו Babylonian loaves which stick to one another; T’bul Yom I, 1 נושכות זו בזו; Ḥall. II, 4 עד שיִשּׁוֹכוּ (Nif.) until the pieces of dough have grown together in rising, contrad. to נגע.
<cite ref="Shabbat 17a:9">Sabb. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>הנושכות</he> clusters of grapes which stick together (and cannot be separated without squeezing some grapes open); a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 1:1:14">Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᵇ</cite> <he>בנ׳</he> if refers to pieces of dough sticking together, contrad. to <cite ref="B00830"><he>בלול</he></cite> kneaded. Ib. III, 59ᶜ top <he>עיסת הנ׳</he> dough made one lump by sticking; <he>נ׳ מאליו</he> sticking together of itself (by rising), opp. <he>הִשִּׁיכוֹ בידו</he> he pasted it together with his hand. Ib. 58ᵇ bot., sq. <he>הנָ׳ תורה</he> the liability to T’rumah, Ḥallah &c. of joined lumps of dough is Biblical law.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:6:6">Y. Kil. IX, end, 32ᵈ</cite> <he>אין אסור אלא נ׳ בלבד</he> the combination of heterogeneous materials (<cite ref="K00674"><he>כִּלְאַיִם</he></cite>) is forbidden only when they are interlaced.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:6:6">Ib.</cite> <he>וההן נו נ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N00290"><he>נוּ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:1">B. Mets. V, 1</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78:9">Gen. R. s. 78</cite> <he>לנַשְּׁכוֹ</he> to bite him. Tanḥ. Vayishl. 4 <he>וינַשְּׁכֶנּוּ</he> and may bite him; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְנוּשָּׁךְ</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 3:6">Tosef. B. Kam. III, 6</cite> <he>או מ׳</he> or he is found to have been bitten.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 9:1">Snh. IX, 1</cite> <he>ה׳ בו וכ׳</he> he brought the serpent near him to bite him, contrad. to <cite ref="U01618"><he>שיסה</he></cite> to set on.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 78a">Ib. 78ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 23b">B. Kam. 23ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00848"><he>נָכַשׁ</he></cite>. Y. Yeb. VIII, 9ᵇ top [read:] <he>מביא נמלין ומַשִּׁיכָן וקוצץ</he> he gets ants and makes them bite (the open wound) and cuts their bodies off (and so the gap is filled), v. Bab.

ib. 76ᵃ.—Trnsf. to paste or press together. Y. Ḥall. III, 59ᶜ top, v. מביא ארבע רובעין ומַשִּׁיךְ he takes four lumps of dough which joined contain four fourths of a Kab and presses them together into one lump; a. e.

B. Mets. 70ᵇ (ref. to Deut. XXIII, 21) מאי תשיך לאו תִּשּׁוֹךְ לא תַּשִּׁיךְ what is meant by tashshikh? Does it not mean thou mayest (or must) take interest? No, it means, thou mayest (or must) pay him interest.
